title: command common
description: Shared definitions of the `workspace` command outputs, referenced by the other documents of this contract through $ref; the document itself is not an output.

code.description: Code of a workspace or of a project: lowercase words of letters and digits joined by single hyphens, starting with a letter, at most 40 characters.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id: ws_ and 26 Crockford base32 characters.

device_id.description: Device id: dev_ and 26 Crockford base32 characters.

binding.description: The checkouts of a project on this machine.

paths.description: Absolute real paths of the checkouts.

primary.description: The checkout used first; one of `paths`.

links_result.description: What `workspace project link|unlink` (or the automatic keeping of the links by attach and sync) did to plans/ and tasks/ of one checkout.

links.description: One row per linkable folder (plans, tasks); empty when the call failed (`problem`).

items.description: What happened to one folder of the checkout.

path.description: The folder (or link) in the checkout.

target.description: The folder of the project in the workspace the link points to.

action.description: `created`: a link was made; `kept`: it was already right; `removed`: unlink took it away; `absent`: unlink found none; `refused`: link found a real folder or a link elsewhere and left it; `skipped`: nothing to do for this folder (see `reason`).

reason.description: Why a folder was refused or skipped: a real folder or file is there; a link to another place is there; the plans of the project are in the checkout, not in the workspace.

exclude.description: The .git/info/exclude file that lists the links; null when the checkout is not a git working tree.

enabled.description: The value of workspace.link_folders this call wrote for the project; null when it wrote none.

problem.description: Error code of a failure that did not stop the command (the setting could not be written; an automatic call failed).
